Additionally, another study showed that assessing patient-reported outcomes via phone interviews (FTE-dependent) versus self-surveys (non-FTE-dependent) yielded similar results, indicating that there may be some consistency in measuring the same thing.

Lastly, a study on hypoglycaemia found a positive correlation between severe and non-severe cases, suggesting that perspective-taking may be associated with better outcomes in managing blood glucose levels.
